title: Sr. Manager, Manufacturing Engineering
text:
**Hyve Company Overview**
-------------------------

Hyve Solutions transforms complex engineering challenges into production reality for technology innovators building AI, cloud, and connected infrastructure. As a US-based manufacturing partner, the company rapidly delivers fast, agile execution through dep technical partnerships and co-innovation, and supply chain clarity. Hyve’s integrated ODM, CM, and SI capabilities eliminate vendor complexity while accelerating time-to-market with single-partner accountability from design through scale. The company co-innovates with deep engineering expertise, treating customer success as its own while building tomorrow's digital infrastructure.

 
 

Hyve Solutions is seeking a highly technical, hands-on Manufacturing Engineering Manager to lead engineering operations within our fast-paced, high-volume PCBA manufacturing environment. This position is responsible for driving manufacturing process development, equipment performance, automation, and continuous improvement while ensuring the successful transition of new products from introduction (NPI) into stable, scalable mass production. The ideal candidate combines strong SMT/PCBA technical expertise with proven leadership capabilities, a passion for solving complex manufacturing challenges, and a proactive, floor-oriented approach to engineering. We are looking for a leader who takes ownership of manufacturing performance, develops strong engineering teams, and drives practical, sustainable solutions that improve quality, throughput, efficiency, and operational scalability.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead, develop, and manage the Manufacturing Engineering team, establishing clear priorities, technical accountability, and performance expectations
* Own manufacturing process development, optimization, and technical support across SMT, automated assembly, soldering, inspection, and related PCBA manufacturing operations
* Lead the transition of new products from NPI into high-volume production, ensuring manufacturing readiness, process capability, equipment qualification, and sustainable production performance
* Partner with NPI, Product Engineering, Test Engineering, Quality, and Operations to identify manufacturability risks, resolve technical challenges, and establish robust production processes
* Drive equipment programming, process parameter optimization, machine capability improvements, and automation initiatives to maximize manufacturing efficiency and reliability
* Provide hands-on technical leadership in troubleshooting complex equipment failures, process defects, yield losses, and recurring production issues
* Establish and improve manufacturing process controls, validation methods, and standardized engineering practices to ensure consistent product quality and repeatability
* Lead root cause investigations and corrective actions for manufacturing-related defects, equipment issues, and process instability
* Evaluate and implement new manufacturing technologies, equipment, tooling, and automation solutions to improve production capability and support business growth
* Support manufacturing capacity expansion, equipment installation, production line integration, and facility transitions while minimizing operational disruptions
* Analyze manufacturing performance metrics, including yield, cycle time, throughput, downtime, and process capability, to identify improvement opportunities and drive measurable results
* Collaborate with Operations, Quality, Maintenance, and Materials teams to establish manufacturing priorities, resolve production constraints, and improve overall operational performance
* Develop and maintain manufacturing engineering standards, process documentation, work instructions, and change control processes to support consistent execution
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on defect reduction, equipment utilization, labor efficiency, cost reduction, and manufacturing scalability
* Develop engineering talent through technical mentorship, structured problem-solving, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement of team capabilities

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, or a related technical field; equivalent experience may be considered
* Minimum of 7 years of progressive manufacturing engineering experience, including 3 years in an engineering leadership or management role, preferred
* Preferred hands-on experience in SMT and PCBA manufacturing processes, including pick and place equipment, solder paste printing, reflow soldering, AOI, AXI, selective soldering, and related manufacturing processes
* Demonstrated success transitioning products from NPI through production qualification, ramp-up, and sustained high-volume manufacturing
* Experience with industrial automation, equipment integration, machine programming, and manufacturing process controls
* Proven ability to lead technical teams, establish accountability, develop engineering talent, and manage competing priorities in a dynamic manufacturing environment
* Strong understanding of manufacturing process validation, root cause analysis, defect reduction, yield improvement, and equipment reliability
* Familiarity with IPC standards, DFM/DFT principles, PFMEA, SPC, and structured problem-solving methodologies
* Familiarity with ISO9001 and ISO14001

**What’s in it for you**
------------------------

Benefit Insurance

* Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* Health Savings Account (HSA)
* Mental Health Care
* 401K with match
* Paid Holidays, Vacation & Sick Days
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Perks at Work
* LEAP Program
* MyFlexPay

***We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.***
